# Ethen Pociask — Protocol Security & AI Infrastructure

**Currently:** Senior Infrastructure Engineer at Eigen Labs (Apr 2024 — Present)

## Selected Work

- **OP Stack threat monitoring** — Built real-time monitoring used in production to secure Base, then helped expand internal coverage across 200+ onchain assets.
- **EigenDA integration** — Managed an Arbitrum Orbit fork integrated with EigenDA through Stage 1 decentralization and worked directly with RaaS partners running the stack.

## What I Build

- **Hermes** — Forked agent harness on home lab (Apple Silicon M3 Ultra, 256GB).
- **HermesNative** — Cross-platform AI agent client in SwiftUI (macOS + iOS). WebSocket JSON-RPC gateway, wiki graph, skills browser, cron management.
- **d‑inference** — Distributed inference engine integration — MLX backend debugging, speculative decoding benchmarks, E2E latency profiling on Apple Silicon.
- **github-flashlight** — LLM-powered codebase knowledge graph generator. Produces structured, cited documentation with verified file:line provenance.

## What I Believe
- Local LLMs are the only real democratization. Everything else is renting your intelligence from someone else's server.
- AI will transform human societies in ways most of us aren't prepared for.
- Decentralization isn't about ideology — it's about removing single points of failure, including people.
- Your job won't love you back. Build skills, not loyalty.
- The best code is the code that solves a real problem. Everything else is cosplay.
- We're all going to die. Spread good vibes. Might as well work on interesting problems.
